name: AMLI Addison

ordinances.description: Change zoning from Residential to Commercial
Case 1753-Z: Rezoning from C-1 (305) to PD O17-006, approval of dev plan for multifamily and future retail space

notes: The development is limited to a maximum of 349 multifamily units and about 5,500 sq ft of future retail space.
The multifamily building and parking garage must be LEED certified.
The units may have no linoleum or Formica surfaces, must have energy efficient appliances, and must have granite, stone or better countertops.
The plan notes that changes to ground-floor residential and to ground-floor facades can be approved administratively by the zoning administrator.

history.077-305: Rezoned the land from Residential to Commercial
history.017-006: Created PD on UC rules: 349 apartments, 5,500 sq ft retail, LEED conditions
